import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):

    k=p[0]; p1=p[1]; p2=p[2]
    return (p[3]+p[4]*P**p1)+(p[5]+p[6]*P**p2+p[7]*P)*(1-np.exp(-k*t))+p[8]*t+p[9]*P*t
